gaps.lead: The soup needed a little more salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a little more = didn't have enough (salt).

gaps.lead: I think learning to use a typewriter is a waste of time.
gaps.sentence: I can't ___ how to use a typewriter.
gaps.explanation: 'A waste of time' becomes 'can't see the point in/of doing it'.

gaps.lead: My grandfather had completely forgotten that he phoned me last night.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather didn't ___ phoning me last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Completely forgotten' becomes 'didn't have any recollection of'.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action continuing from a past point to now: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: They have accused the mayor of corruption.
gaps.explanation: Active 'they have accused him of' becomes passive: has been accused of.

gaps.lead: Reporters expect the trial to last several weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Reporters expect it to last' becomes 'it is expected to last'.
